# Where these logos come from

The logos in this folder mark, in the README, the programs, services and systems Hornhoof works with. Each mark belongs to its owner and does not mean its owner supports Hornhoof. The drawings are kept as their source publishes them. The one change is the colour of marks whose source leaves it to the page: black in the light file, white in the `-dark` file, so the mark shows on both GitHub themes.

| File | Mark | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `claude-code.svg` | Claude Code | Lobe Icons, `claudecode-color.svg` | MIT |
| `codex.svg` | Codex | Lobe Icons, `codex-color.svg` | MIT |
| `kimi.svg`, `kimi-dark.svg` | Kimi | Lobe Icons, `kimi-color.svg`; its letter, drawn in the page colour, is black or white | MIT |
| `zai.svg`, `zai-dark.svg` | Z.ai | Lobe Icons, `zai.svg`, black or white | MIT |
| `antigravity.svg` | Google Antigravity | Lobe Icons, `antigravity-color.svg` | MIT |
| `anthropic.svg`, `anthropic-dark.svg` | Anthropic | Lobe Icons, `anthropic.svg`, black or white | MIT |
| `openai.svg`, `openai-dark.svg` | OpenAI | Lobe Icons, `openai.svg`, black or white | MIT |
| `openclaw.svg` | OpenClaw | Lobe Icons, `openclaw-color.svg` | MIT |
| `hermes-agent.svg`, `hermes-agent-dark.svg` | Hermes Agent | Lobe Icons, `hermesagent.svg`, black or white | MIT |
| `telegram.svg` | Telegram | Simple Icons, `telegram.svg`, in its colour from Simple Icons, `#26A5E4` | CC0 1.0 |
| `macos.svg`, `macos-dark.svg` | Apple | Simple Icons, `apple.svg`, in its colour from Simple Icons, `#000000`, or white | CC0 1.0 |
| `linux.svg`, `linux-dark.svg` | Linux | Simple Icons, `linux.svg`, black or white | CC0 1.0 |
| `avaclone.svg` | AvaClone | The AvaClone tab icon, `public/favicon.svg` in [Invariant0x/AvaClone-Frontend](https://github.com/Invariant0x/AvaClone-Frontend), without its comment | Ivan Korol's own; AvaClone is his product |
| `windows.svg`, `windows-dark.svg` | WSL | Made for Hornhoof: a plain tile with the letters WSL, as Windows has no logo under a free licence and Hornhoof runs there in WSL 2 | MIT, as Hornhoof |

Lobe Icons: [lobehub/lobe-icons](https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-icons), the files of the npm package `@lobehub/icons-static-svg` 1.102.0, folder `icons`.

Simple Icons: [simple-icons/simple-icons](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons), the files of the npm package `simple-icons` 16.37.0, folder `icons`, under [CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Its [disclaimer](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/blob/develop/DISCLAIMER.md) asks users to respect each brand's own rules for its mark.
